subject: You're welcome to invite collaborators and friends

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: You're welcome to invite collaborators and friends
parts:
Hi,

as a step towards making aroma.affymetrix public, you are now welcome
to invite your collaborators and friends to use aroma.affymetrix.

Please forward me (to hb @ stat . berkeley . edu) their email address
and I will send them an invitation. As you know, they will need to
have a Google Account in that email address to access the group pages,
i.e. the easiest is if they use an existing gmail address (but you can
get a Google Account for any address).

Cheers

Henrik
